products.name: Aurelia Six-Arm Chandelier
products.short_description: Six curved brass arms, pleated ivory shades and a hand-blown glass column. A classic chandelier with a softer, warmer light.
products.description:
Aurelia takes the shape of a traditional six-arm chandelier and slims it down: lighter arms, a single glass column and shades that sit low, so the light falls on the table rather than in your eyes.

The shades are pleated cotton on a brass rim. Swap them for the linen or smoke colourway to suit the room.
products.materials: Solid brass, pleated cotton shades, mouth-blown glass

products.name: Seraphine Chandelier
products.short_description: Slender brass arms and five cream shades on a long drop rod, sized for a dining table.
products.description:
Seraphine hangs on a long rod, so it works under high ceilings and over a dining table alike. Five arms curl up from a turned brass body, each with its own cream shade.

Shorten the rod at fitting time to set the exact height you want.

products.name: Versailles Twelve-Light Chandelier
products.short_description: Twelve candle lights in two tiers, with cut-glass bobèches and a twisted iron drop rod.
products.description:
A grand chandelier in the French manner: twelve candle lights on two tiers of scrolled brass arms, each resting in a cut-glass bobèche that throws small sparks of light across the ceiling.

Use warm candle bulbs and a dimmer for the full effect.
products.materials: Cast brass, cut glass, wrought iron rod

products.name: Opal Globe Pendant
products.short_description: A hand-blown opal glass globe on a fine cord. It turns the bulb into an even, glare-free glow.
products.description:
The simplest pendant there is, done well: a sphere of opal glass that hides the bulb completely and spreads the light in every direction.

Hang one over a side table, or three in a row over a kitchen island. The fitting comes in nickel, brass or black.
products.materials: Mouth-blown opal glass, metal fitting, fabric cord

products.name: Foundry Enamel Pendant
products.short_description: A factory pendant with a sage enamel shade, cast junction box and wire guard.
products.description:
Foundry is modelled on the lamps that once hung over workshop benches: a heavy enamel shade, a cast junction box and a wire guard over the glass.

It hangs on a steel chain, so the drop is easy to adjust.
products.materials: Enamelled steel, cast aluminium, glass, steel chain

products.name: Lotus Silk Lantern Pendant
products.short_description: Six hand-painted silk panels in a carved hardwood frame, finished with red silk tassels.
products.description:
Each of the six panels is painted by hand with plum blossom on silk, then set into a carved hardwood frame with dragon-head brackets.

Lit from inside, the silk glows a warm cream and the branches stand out in shadow.
products.materials: Carved hardwood, hand-painted silk, silk tassels

products.name: Gothic Lantern Pendant
products.short_description: Wrought scrollwork and glass panels around a single warm bulb.
products.description:
A lantern for halls and stairwells, with leaf-shaped scrollwork in aged bronze wrapped around four glass panels.

Pair it with a warm filament bulb to bring out the colour of the metal.

products.name: Arc Desk Lamp
products.short_description: The spring-balanced architect's lamp: two arms, one hand to move it.
products.description:
Springs balance both arms, so the lamp stays exactly where you leave it, low over a sketch or high over a keyboard.

The base clamps to any desk up to 6 cm thick.

products.name: Pipe Table Lamp
products.short_description: Pipe fittings, a wide steel shade and a filament bulb.
products.description:
Built from real pipe fittings on a weighted base, with a wide steel shade that tilts to point the light where you need it.

Comes with a warm filament bulb.
products.materials: Galvanised steel pipe, steel shade, cast iron base

products.name: Rosa Oil Lamp
products.short_description: A hand-painted porcelain font, brass collar and tall glass chimney. Burns lamp oil for a real flame.
products.description:
Rosa is a working paraffin lamp: fill the porcelain font, trim the wick and light it for a steady, flickering flame behind the glass chimney.

The roses are painted by hand, so each lamp is a little different.

products.name: Bracket Wall Light
products.short_description: A black enamel cone on a swan-neck arm and an aged brass backplate.
products.description:
Mount it beside a mirror, over a bedside table or along a hallway. The swan-neck arm holds the cone shade away from the wall and points it down.

Wire it in, or use the plug-in kit.

products.name: Bulkhead Wall Light
products.short_description: A cast iron cage around ribbed glass, made for porches, hallways and garden walls.
products.description:
The bulkhead light from ships and engine rooms, in cast iron with a ribbed glass cover.

It works indoors and on a sheltered porch.

products.name: Storm Lantern
products.short_description: The hurricane lantern: a glass globe in a brass cage, with a wick you can turn down low.
products.description:
A classic storm lantern that stays lit in a breeze. Turn the brass wheel to raise or lower the flame.

Hang it from the bail handle or stand it on a table.

products.name: Baroque Candelabra Set
products.short_description: Three brass candle holders: a single stick, a three-light and a five-light candelabra.
products.description:
A set of three in cast brass, from a single candlestick to a five-light candelabra. Group them down a dining table or along a mantel.

Takes standard dinner candles.
